title: 2175. Menu-Driven Calculator

Menu-Driven Calculator
60
Medium
Problem Statement
Write a menu-driven calculator that keeps reading a choice and performing the operation until the choice is Exit.
Description
The program repeatedly reads a choice and does the following. Choice 1: read two integers and print their sum. Choice 2: read two integers and print their difference (first number - second number). Choice 3: read two integers and print their product. Choice 4: print Exit and stop the program. Any other choice: print Invalid Choice and continue with the next choice. Do not print the menu.
Input Description
Several lines. Each operation starts with a line containing the choice (an integer). For choice 1, 2 or 3, two more lines follow, containing the first integer and the second integer. The input ends with the choice 4. (-1000 <= first integer, second integer <= 1000)
Output Description
For each choice, print the result on its own line: the sum, the difference or the product as an integer, the word Invalid Choice, or the word Exit.
